blocks.text: Day 1 · On arrival, your driver takes you to your hotel. On the way you will immediately feel the hustle and bustle of carioca life (the cariocas are Rio’s locals): the city noise, hillside neighbourhoods in the background, the golden sands of Copacabana dotted with foot-volley players and the rainforest all around. Once at your hotel, spend the day as you wish: why not walk a few blocks to the beach, rent a sun umbrella and deck chairs, and let the children play in the shallow water?

blocks.text: Day 2 · Breakfast at the hotel, then a half-day excursion to Sugar Loaf. Your guide takes you to Praia Vermelha (Red Beach), a quieter beach at the foot of the mountain, where a thrilling cable car ride takes you up to the summit and a spectacular view of the whole city: Christ the Redeemer to the north, Copacabana and Ipanema curving towards the Two Brothers mountain to the west, Botafogo beach and the financial district to the east. Keep an eye out for mischievous monkeys on the mountainside!
